whole_canonical_process.CPU_scope: Exact wait4 of canonical supervisor, including its waited children and final inner closure
whole_canonical_process.RSS_method: Exact wait4 high-water for this PID and waited descendants; not summed concurrent memory

interpretation.candidate: Exact candidate audits occurred after primary inference closed and never changed acceptance. Cached kernel-prior constants are reused algebraically, with no prior-function evaluation.
interpretation.error: e(x)=computed compact likelihood cost minus computed exact-model likelihood cost; priors cancel at each matched point.
interpretation.memory: One candidate replaces the old learner. Host two-arm/oracle/trace storage is counted separately; target stack, IRQ/libm, ADC and checkpoint drivers remain unmeasured planning obligations.
interpretation.nodes: These are coupled metric directions and curvature-predicted target paths, not nonlinear profiles, posterior samples or credible-interval endpoints.
interpretation.offset: A parameter-independent offset does not alter normalized odds. Both bank-origin and common-a7 offsets/centered errors are retained.
interpretation.old_anchor_run: The previous autonomous-anchor invocation remains failed; its independently verified generation7 is the declared warm representation origin, not a successful old-run closure.
interpretation.oscillation: max(e)-min(e) bounds absolute log-odds distortion only between available nodes in the declared finite set. Unavailable nodes remain explicit; no probability mass is discarded or renormalized.
